description: A product configurator for choosing a model, finish, and storage, with a live price and Add to Bag button.
overview: At `md:` the section is a two-column grid: a large product image on the left and the configuration options on the right; on smaller screens the image becomes a `4/3` panel above the options. Model and storage choices use `RadioGroup` and `RadioGroupItem` inside `Label` cards with visually hidden radios, and storage options sit in a three-column grid. Finishes are round color swatches built with `ToggleGroup` and `ToggleGroupItem`. The image cross-fades between finishes, and a sticky footer shows the price, a 12-month monthly estimate, and a `Button`.
usage: Edit the `models`, `finishes`, and `storage` constants at the top of the file. Each model has a `name` and base `price`, each finish has a `name`, a CSS `color` for its swatch, an `image`, and `alt` text, and each storage option has a `size` and an `extra` price. The selected model, finish, storage size, and an `added` flag are held in `React.useState`; the price is the model price plus the storage surcharge. Replace the Add to Bag `onClick`, which only sets `added`, with your cart logic, and update the New eyebrow and the Buy Phone Pro heading.
notes: Each `RadioGroup` and the `ToggleGroup` has an `aria-label`, and each swatch has an `aria-label` with its finish name. Inactive finish images are marked `aria-hidden`. The price area uses `aria-live="polite"` so price changes are announced. Images load from Unsplash through the `photo` helper; replace them with your own product photography. Transitions are disabled with `motion-reduce:`.
